auth.refresh: POST https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token with refresh_token; refresh token expires if unused for 60 days, each use resets it to 60 days

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Marketplace publishing requires app review (EXPANSION-A); app stays DRAFT and is unlisted
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Pipedrive user with access installs the LOVELEEDAY app and accepts the scopes; admin may be needed for company-wide data.

sandbox.how_to_get: Developer sandbox account at developers.pipedrive.com (daniel-sandbox12), self-serve

rate_limits: Daily token budget 30,000 x plan multiplier (1 Lite to 7 Ultimate) x seats, resets at midnight server time; burst per 2 s per token with OAuth: Lite 80, Growth 160, Premium 400, Ultimate 480; Search API 10 per 2 s; 429 on burst, repeated abuse gets 403
incremental_sync: UNVERIFIED (updated_since on list endpoints and webhooks; not fetched)
blockers: Only ONE callback URL allowed; only the portal callback is set (no localhost).
